text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening stance and repeated claim that driverless cars should be brought into our lives","quality":"positioning","description":"It states a definite argument early and keeps returning to the same side throughout the essay."},{"evidence":"mentions half a million miles without a crash and driver alerts for driveways and traffic issues","quality":"textual support","description":"It uses multiple details from the article to back up the argument rather than relying only on opinion."},{"evidence":"explains safety, distraction, and warning systems across several paragraphs","quality":"development","description":"It expands ideas with reasons and examples instead of leaving points briefly stated."},{"evidence":"connects self-driving cars to easier rides and less likely accidents","quality":"reasoning","description":"It more directly explains why the article’s details support the pro-driverless position."},{"evidence":"includes opening question, body paragraphs, and a closing appeal","quality":"essay organization","description":"It has a clearer overall structure with an introduction, supporting body, and conclusion."}]}
